instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Forestry management cooperative overseeing 5,000 hectares of sustainable pine and eucalyptus plantation. This enterprise focuses on maximizing timber yield efficiency while ensuring long-term carbon sequestration credits for premium markets. The operation is a tight-knit team where operational expertise outweighs specialized R&D roles.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
answers.strategicGoals: Our board has set an ambitious revenue target of reaching €50M ARR within 5 years from our current base. This requires us to expand our addressable market, potentially pivot pricing models from one-time to recurring revenue, and build a repeatable enterprise sales motion. We need to identify the highest-leverage growth levers without overextending our cash runway.
answers.additionalContext: We have a new CEO who joined 3 months ago from a more digitally mature industry. She has signaled that innovation and digital transformation will be top strategic priorities, replacing the previous leadership's conservative, cost-cutting orientation. The organization is cautiously optimistic but also uncertain about what concrete changes to expect.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

opportunities.title: Optimized Harvest Predictive Analytics
opportunities.rationale: Implementing localized satellite imagery and drone data analysis can optimize planting density and harvest timing, directly increasing yield efficiency without major capital expenditure.

first_actions: Pilot a low-cost drone mapping service for one hectare.
Integrate basic sensor data into existing operational dashboards.
execution_plan.success_metric: 5% increase in yield efficiency across the pilot plot.
milestones: Q1: Data acquisition and baseline modeling complete.
Q2: Integration into existing operational workflow.

opportunities.title: Direct-to-Consumer Carbon Credit Aggregation Platform
opportunities.rationale: Developing a proprietary platform that transparently aggregates and verifies carbon credit streams from micro-plots, allowing us to bypass intermediaries and capture higher margins.

first_actions: Develop a core API for tracking verifiable metrics.
Form a small external consultancy team focused on compliance.
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 10 verified carbon credit sales within the first year.
milestones: Q3: MVP launch of aggregation platform.
Q4: Integration with primary CRM/sales pipeline.

next_steps.action: Form a cross-functional innovation task force to prioritize the harvest analytics project.
Conduct market sizing and competitive landscape analysis for carbon credit aggregation software.

key_weaknesses: Lack of dedicated R&D talent leading to opportunistic, rather than proactive, innovation.
Over-reliance on single decision-makers (owner alone) increasing strategic risk and slowing high-impact radical initiatives.
Limited capital allocated to structured experimentation, making the 9% budget highly restrictive for growth objectives.
